sources.label: NSCP 2015, Chapter 2 — Seismic Zone 4 Classification for the Philippines
sources.description: Classifies most of the Philippines as Seismic Zone 4 (highest seismicity). Specifies seismic design categories based on occupancy and soil type.

sources.label: NSCP 2015, Section 2.14 — Seismic Bracing Requirements for Mechanical and Electrical Equipment
sources.description: Specific seismic bracing requirements for: suspended equipment (cable bracing/friction clips at 6-12 ft intervals), floor-mounted equipment (anchors with 200% safety factor), and piping/ductwork (flexible connections).

sources.label: NSCP 2015, Table 2.15 — Component Importance Factors for Non-Structural Systems
sources.description: Importance factors for non-structural components. Life safety systems (fire alarm, emergency lighting) have higher importance factors.
